definitions.explanation: A place for cooking, especially a shared or communal cooking facility at a campsite, dormitory, or similar setting. Less commonly used for home kitchens, where 台所 or キッチン are preferred.

examples.japanese: {炊事場|すいじば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare a meal in the cooking area.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧{場|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炊事場|すいじば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The cooking area at the campsite has running water.

examples.japanese: {炊事場|すいじば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧あと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧づけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please clean up after using the cooking area.

notes:
{炊事場|すいじば} refers to a cooking facility, especially a shared or communal one. It is rarely used for a home kitchen.

FORMS:
⟦{炊事|すいじ}→炊事：00385_suiji⟧ (cooking) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place)

TYPICAL SETTINGS:
- ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧{場|じょう} (campsite)
- ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧ (dormitory)
- {合宿所|がっしゅくじょ} (training camp lodge)
- ⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧ (mountain hut)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {炊事場|すいじば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cook in the cooking area
- {炊事場|すいじば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use the cooking facility
- {炊事場|すいじば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧づける: to clean up the cooking area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧: kitchen (home, traditional)
- ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧: kitchen (home, modern/Western style)
- ⟦{厨房|ちゅうぼう}→厨房：11940_chuubou⟧: kitchen (professional, restaurant)
